title: SalesforceContract - Data API
description: Read-only virtual object used in the Your Account App. Represents contract information related to your organization’s Salesforce subscription.

AutoRenewCode.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
AutoRenewCode.description: Determines if contract renews automatically Possible values are: No Yes

BillingAddressCity.description: Details for the billing address. Maximum size is 40 characters.

BillingAddressCountry.description: Details for the billing address of this contract. Maximum size is 80 characters.

BillingAddressPostalCode.description: Details for the billing address of this contract. Maximum size is 20 characters.

BillingAddressState.description: Details for the billing address of this contract. Maximum size is 80 characters.

BillingAddressStreet.description: Street address for the billing address of this contract.

BillingEmail.description: Email address for billing this contract.

BillingPhone.description: Phone number for billing this contract.

CreditCardType.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
CreditCardType.description: Credit card provider. Possible values are: AmericanExpress— JCB MasterCard Visa

ExternalId.description: External reference ID set by Salesforce.

FirstNameOnCreditCard.description: Cardholder’s first name on the credit card.

LastNameOnCreditCard.description: Cardholder’s last name on the credit card.

PaymentTerm.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
PaymentTerm.description: Payment terms definition. Possible values are: Net0—Due upon receipt Net10—DD-Germany: Net 10 Net30— Net30EOM—JP-Net 30 EOM Net45— Net60— Net60EOM—JP-Net 60 EOM

PaymentType.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
PaymentType.description: Payment type definition. Possible values are: Check CreditCard— DirectDebit— WireTransfer—

SalesforceContractStatus.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
SalesforceContractStatus.description: The status of the contract Possible values are: Activated Draft Expired Terminated inApproval—

ShippingAddressCity.description: Details of the shipping address. City maximum size is 40 characters.

ShippingAddressCountry.description: Details of the shipping address. Country maximum size is 80 characters.

ShippingAddressPostalCode.description: Details of the shipping address. Postal code maximum size is 20 characters.

ShippingAddressState.description: Details of the shipping address. State maximum size is 80 characters.

ShippingAddressStreet.description: The street address of the shipping address. Maximum of 255 characters.

usage: Used by Your Account to manage contracts related to your organization’s Salesforce subscription. Read-only.
associated_objects: This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.
